answer.text: Same charges whether on-boarded through a distributor or directly
Clients may be onboarded directly without distribution intermediation, and no charges except statutory charges shall be levied at direct onboarding
Applies only to Cat II AIFs

explanation.text: The Logic: Per the NISM Series XXI-A workbook (page 112), portfolio managers shall provide an option to clients to be on-boarded directly, without intermediation of persons engaged in distribution services. At direct on-boarding, no charges except statutory charges shall be levied. The Trap: Direct on-boarding is about removing distribution intermediation and statutory-only charges at onboarding; it is not restricted to a particular client category like AIF Cat II. Note: Source: NISM Series XXI-A workbook, page 112.
